metadata.description: Apple IIe (native 560x192 streaming raster, no frame buffer; WOZ floppy drive via Pocket SDRAM, on-screen keyboard; NTSC color; APF sync contract fix; merged Color Preset option; diagnostics hidden while keyboard is open; joy2key gamepad-to-keystroke presets or .a2k profiles (per-slot Custom option, off.a2k off-profile); docked USB HID keyboard, Player-3 slot; savestate save/load; Mockingboard card (slot 4) with volume slider; synthesized floppy drive sound; per-source volume ladders (Mockingboard/floppy/beeper); optional synthesized HDV seek sound)
metadata.author: Newsdee
